purpose: Four visual concepts only; no application implementation

concepts.title: Backline
concepts.direction: Analog amplifier and touring road-case visual language translated into flat software. Deep charcoal and blackened steel with almost imperceptible grain, bone-white typography, slim metal-like separator rules, numbered channel-strip rows and narrow engraved labels. The project table spans almost the entire width; every project is a disciplined horizontal rack-like strip. Logo and Projects form a compact strong header; actions at the upper right. Selected row is a graphite panel with a tiny purple indicator and a strong left edge, not a large purple fill. Resource links below are two compact dark equipment-label panels with subtly screened architecture art. A little muted amber in tiny numbering marks. Strong, tactile, dry, severe, stylish. No photorealistic hardware, knobs, meters, rivets or excessive bevels.

concepts.title: Monolith
concepts.direction: Sculptural architectural brutalism. Compose an asymmetric masthead with an enormous condensed QUADER wordmark in the left part of the header, small Projects identification and the normal actions to the right; the actual table uses all available width. Oversized pale project titles within disciplined rows, tiny monospaced metadata, confident graphic row numbers, generous separation between rows while keeping all four visible. Selected row is a flat pale stone-gray band with dark legible text and a small purple cut at the left edge. Other rows recede into a near-black graphite field. No box around the entire table. Bottom resource areas are two understated editorial footer columns separated by one rule, with small architectural crops. Monumental typography and negative space create the identity. Subtle graphite grain in empty dark zones only; geometric, contemporary, memorable, not a website landing page.

concepts.title: Bootleg
concepts.direction: An underground rock zine translated into precise professional UI. A warm off-white header band takes around the upper fifth of the window, bold black condensed QUADER masthead with the purple mark, Projects and compact dark action buttons. Below it a charcoal project list arranged like a gig set-list: large visible row numbers, strong names, crisply aligned small metadata and paths. Controlled photocopy grain/halftone only in the header margins and resource artwork. Selected row has a thin violet hand-printed-looking underline / narrow label edge, but letters and controls stay perfectly crisp. Footer tutorial/docs strips use black and cream xerographic architecture images and exact functional labels. Asymmetrical graphic accents balanced by a rigid reading grid. Visibly different from a conventional dark app. No illegible distressing, text collisions, collage clutter, torn paper over data, stickers, slogans or extra controls.

concepts.title: Overdrive
concepts.direction: A lean early-2000s industrial creator-tool aesthetic reinterpreted at contemporary clarity. Obsidian and graphite planes, silver-white wide display lettering for QUADER, tiny restrained violet accents, sharp chamfered panel ends, ultra-fine horizontal speed-line separators. Strong angular compact header combining logo, Projects and the existing two actions. Each table row is a flat segmented strip: prominent project identity in a wide left compartment, date and editor version in narrow clean right compartments, overflow at end. Only selected row gets a crisp ultraviolet perimeter and one small solid violet end-cap. Resource areas below form two long angular plates with high-contrast architectural art fading into black, no curved corners. The layout feels fast and engineered, distinctive even at a glance. Use a clean black canvas and limited accents, no neon glow, glassmorphism, rainbow gradients, 3D chrome text, sci-fi HUD clutter or gaming dashboard widgets.
